L15: 【5†Image: Voorkant】【6†René Raaijmakers†www.google.nl】SPIE - 663 pagina's In ASML's Architects René Raaijmakers returns to the birthplace of the wafer stepper and the roots of ASML's stunning global success. He chronicles the engineers' all-consuming race to surpass the rest, providing a vivid window into the unique culture that spawned the world's finest chipmaking technology: the all-or-nothing, go-for-the-gold mindset that still permeates ASML.
